# Telegram Media Downloader

Self-hosted Telegram media downloader with a native Go backend and an embedded
browser dashboard. Production runs one tgdl-server binary; no Node runtime,
JavaScript server, npm installation or runtime fallback is required. Browser
JavaScript remains in core-service/internal/webassets/public/.

This branch is under development. Current scope is core Telegram downloads,
download-time deduplication, queue reliability, files, dashboard and access
controls. Optional feature migration is not required for historical parity.

## Read first

- README.md: native Go and Docker setup.
- docs/GO-MIGRATION-STATUS.md: verified behavior, tests and remaining limitations.
- docs/DEPLOY.md: storage, process environment, native first-password setup.
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: package ownership and data flow.
- CONTRIBUTING.md: Go build/test/check and browser asset changes.
- SECURITY.md: security reporting and deployment practices.

## Implementation

- core-service/cmd/tgdl-server: server, setup, backup decrypt/restore commands.
- core-service/internal/accounts and telegram: account ownership, gotd sessions,
  login and Telegram updates.
- core-service/internal/engine and download: durable work, ingestion, download-time
  deduplication, verified reuse, streaming hashing and publication recovery.
- core-service/internal/app: HTTP/WebSocket routes, authorization and integration.
- core-service/internal/store: SQLite schema and migrations.
- core-service/internal/webassets/public: canonical browser assets.

Run make build, make test or make check. Historical contract snapshots remain in
tests/contract; their removed recorder/backend are available at Git commit
aa83eed. Sidecar projects are independent and are not part of core cleanup.
